name: Landfall
description: Act 2, chapter `kindred` (STORY.md §16): the `landfall` mission, our expedition to Kindred's colony on Verdance. A green coast (the sea is kept: open water along the south-west); we land on the south side (the Core's pad). A river runs from the north-east hills to the sea between us and the colony, with one shallow ford on the line to the gate. Kindred hold the north: an 80 × 80 u plateau, levelled and cleared, for their colony and the prebuilt outposts the engine will add (`council-hall` at its centre, where we meet Marrow and play `cine-marrow`, then `three-histories`), a ramp up its south face to `kindred-gate` (send a drone in without firing; counter `kindred-shots`), and their fields on the flat ground to the west (`kindred-fields`, painted lush). Lush wildlife in four herds; two nests far east and west; packs ×0.7. Kindred is a faction here (team 2, neutral; kindred-hostile turns it hostile, kindred-ally allies it): a walled colony on the plateau (council hall = a Civilian Center behind council-hall, habitats, lab, med bay, memorial, solar, battery, radar, four turrets), hydroponics in the fields, guards at the gate, a patrol along the wall and two Rovers in the fields. Expedition: 900 alloys, 3 drones, 4 Rovers, 2 Lancers, an Engineer (packs ×0.7, two nests).
